Seamless Interiors by karsontr13 — https://github.com/karsontr13/TLD-Seamless-Interiors (MelonLoader mod for The Long
Dark; walking into a building without a loading screen). The repository states no license. TLDCoop_DLC carries a C++
port of it (src/seamless_interiors.cpp, src/seamless_interiors.h), made from its source (SI 2.4.1, commit
2d75c70d9d2f45a0c396fca5f427815040154c46), with the author's permission (given to Karol). No MelonLoader or files of
the mod are needed.

SeamlessInteriorsMod.Configs.cs here is the mod's own building list, copied unchanged from that commit; the build does
not compile it: tools/seamless/gen_configs.py turns it into src/seamless_configs.inc. Do not redistribute it separately
from TLDCoop_DLC without the author's permission.
